latestVersion.changelog:
v1.1.0 — Bug-fix and quality release.

Critical fixes:
- BUG: Fresh runs failed validation immediately. init wrote literal placeholder "pass|fail|blocked|inconclusive" as the status bullet, which the validator rejected. Now defaults to "inconclusive" so the workflow is usable end-to-end.
- BUG: backup-repo.sh crashed with "local: can only be used in a function" (line 111). Rewritten to build the zip command as an array, no eval, no in-script local outside functions.
- BUG: --rollback silently ran "git checkout ." on the entire repo when called with a non-existent or empty run directory, accidentally reverting unrelated work. Now refuses to run without a real run dir AND a defined target list (from --scope or proposal.md "Files To Edit").
- BUG: Unicode objectives (Hindi, Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, etc.) were stripped to empty by overly aggressive sed sanitizers. New sanitize_oneline only removes newlines and backticks; preserves all UTF-8 text.
- BUG: --auto-detect-validation silently overrode --validation-gate when both passed. Explicit gate now wins with a clear stderr notice.
- BUG: detect-validation-gate.sh dedup loop tripped "set -u" on empty arrays in some bash versions. Rewritten with explicit existence checks.
- BUG: logging-utils.sh log_command used eval on its argument (shell-injection risk). Rewritten to use direct argv expansion.

New features:
- set-status.sh helper to mark baseline / validation / outcome / proposal status without hand-editing markdown. Validates the status value before writing.
- export-improvement-run-json.py --strict flag exits non-zero when statuses or hypothesis text are still placeholders, so CI does not silently accept incomplete runs.
- detect-validation-gate.sh now picks pnpm/yarn/npm based on lockfile presence, prefers ./gradlew over gradle when present, and only emits a default test command when one is actually detected.
- LICENSE file shipped with the skill.
- README and SKILL.md rewritten with Quick Start that walks through the full lifecycle including set-status calls.

Improvements:
- All bash scripts use safe argument handling — no eval, no shell=True equivalent, no implicit string-joined arrays.
- Validator now accepts both "- " and "* " bullet markers under status sections.
- Cleaner error messages on every failure path.
- Test coverage of every fix was verified end-to-end before publishing.
